description.mn: Acqua di Parma Magnolia Nobile: Эмэгтэйчүүдэд зориулсан цэцэгсийн үнэр (EDP). Эхний ноот: цитрон, нимбэг, бергамот; зүрхний ноот: магнолия, жасмин, сарнай, тубероз; суурь ноот: ветивер.
description.en: Acqua di Parma Magnolia Nobile by Acqua di Parma is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Acqua di Parma Magnolia Nobile was launched in 2009. The nose behind this fragrance is Antoine Maisondieu. Top notes are Citron, Lemon and Bergamot; middle notes are Magnolia, Jasmine, Rose and Tuberose; base notes are Vetiver, Sandalwood, Patchouli and Vanilla.
